attributes.label: Temperature Control
attributes.description: Whether the kettle offers variable/precise temperature settings vs. boil-only, and the accuracy of those settings.

attributes.label: Capacity
attributes.description: The water volume the kettle can hold, affecting how many cups or brew sessions can be served per fill.

attributes.label: Heating Speed
attributes.description: How quickly the kettle brings water to the target temperature, typically expressed in wattage or time-to-boil.

attributes.label: Keep-Warm / Hold Mode
attributes.description: Ability to maintain water at a set temperature for an extended period after reaching it, and the maximum hold duration.

attributes.label: Spout Design
attributes.description: Shape and precision of the spout — gooseneck for controlled pour-over flow vs. wide-mouth for speed and convenience.

attributes.label: Smart Connectivity
attributes.description: App control, WiFi/Bluetooth scheduling, and integration with smart-home ecosystems.

attributes.label: Material & Build Quality
attributes.description: Inner and outer construction materials — stainless steel, BPA-free plastic, glass — affecting durability, taste neutrality, and aesthetics.

attributes.label: Display & Interface
attributes.description: Presence and quality of an onboard display (LCD, LED) and physical controls for reading and setting temperature.

attributes.label: Base & Cord Design
attributes.description: Whether the kettle uses a 360° cordless base, cord length, and how easy it is to lift and manoeuvre.

attributes.label: Noise Level
attributes.description: How loud the kettle is during heating and boiling — relevant for quiet kitchens, offices, or early-morning use.

attributes.label: Brewing Extras
attributes.description: Bonus features aimed at specialty coffee or tea brewing: built-in stopwatch/timer, brew presets, or tea-specific modes.

attributes.label: Price / Value
attributes.description: Price, budget fit and overall value

clusters.label: Pour-Over & Specialty Coffee Enthusiast
clusters.description: Buyers brewing pour-over, V60, Chemex, or AeroPress who need precise temperature, a gooseneck spout, and timing tools to replicate café-quality results at home.

clusters.label: Smart Home & Tech-Forward User
clusters.description: Buyers who want app scheduling, voice-assistant integration, and remote control to fit the kettle into a connected morning routine.

clusters.label: Everyday Convenience Seeker
clusters.description: Buyers who primarily want fast boiling, large capacity, and simple operation for tea, instant noodles, or general hot-water tasks — minimal fuss.

clusters.label: Health & Material-Conscious Buyer
clusters.description: Buyers focused on safe, taste-neutral materials (stainless steel interior, BPA-free) and clean build quality to avoid plastic off-flavours or leaching.

clusters.label: Office / Desk User
clusters.description: Buyers using the kettle in a workspace who prioritise quiet operation, compact size, keep-warm functionality, and a tidy cordless base.
